title: Niacin supplementation in a child with novel MTTN variant m.5670A>G causing early onset mitochondrial myopathy and NAD+ deficiency.

outcomes.name: disease progression
outcomes.effect_text: did not stop disease progression; meager clinical response

outcomes.name: metabolomics profile (tryptophan metabolites and lipid-metabolic markers)
outcomes.effect_text: overall shift of metabolism towards controls

outcomes.name: amino acid levels
outcomes.effect_text: most amino acids did not respond to niacin therapy
